title: Curious Infant in Polka Dot Outfit, 1960 Vintage B&W Baby Snapshot Photo
description: A sweet black-and-white domestic snapshot from December 1960 featuring an alert baby looking upward while wearing a cozy polka-dot sleeper or gown. An adult hand wearing a wedding band rests gently against the baby's chest for support. The print features decorative scalloped/deckle edges and a top border date stamp reading 'DEC • 60', exemplifying personal home photography during the post-war American baby boom era.
